readmeMarkdown: # Antigravity Community Plugin Marketplace > **Browse, security-audit, install, and update community-made Google Antigravity App plugins directly from the Antigravity sidebar—backed by a public, Ed25519-signed registry.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antigravity-community-marketplace.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antigravity-community-marketplace) [![Public Registry](https://img.shields.io/badge/Registry-domush.github.io-10b981?style=flat&logo=github)](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-registry/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Antigravity App Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity%20App-Native%20Plugin-6366f1.svg)]() 🌐 **Preview on the Web:** Want to explore the catalog before installing? **[Browse the Community Plugin Marketplace online →](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-registry/)** to search plugins, inspect security audit summaries, and discover what’s available right in your browser. > **Disclaimer:** This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Always review audit findings before installing elevated or high-risk plugins. --- ## Requirements * **Antigravity App:** v2.34.0 or newer (required for MCP App sidebar UIs) * **Node.js:** v22 or newer available on `PATH` --- ## Quick Install (10 Seconds) Install directly into Google Antigravity using `npx`: ```bash # Global install (available across all Antigravity workspaces) npx antigravity-community-marketplace install # Or per-project install (scoped to the current workspace only) npx antigravity-community-marketplace install --workspace ``` Restart or reload the **Google Antigravity App**, and **Community Plugins** appears immediately in your sidebar (installed into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-community-marketplace`, or `.agents/plugins/agy-community-marketplace` for workspace installs). ### Uninstall ```bash # Remove global install npx antigravity-community-marketplace uninstall # Or remove per-project workspace install npx antigravity-community-marketplace uninstall --workspace ``` ### Manual Install 1. Download and extract the latest release archive into your global plugins folder: * **macOS / Linux:** `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-community-marketplace/` * **Windows:** `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-community-marketplace\` 2. Reload or restart the Antigravity App. --- ## Opening the Marketplace Click **Community Plugins** under **Plugins** in the Antigravity App left sidebar (or open it in the side panel via the `open_marketplace` tool). You can also browse the catalog in any browser at `https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-registry/`. --- ## Key Features * **Global & Project Installs:** Install plugins globally (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`) or scoped to the active project (`.agents/plugins/`). * **Non-Destructive Enable / Disable:** Pause any installed plugin without deleting its files or local settings; disabled plugins move to a sibling `plugins-disabled/` folder and stop triggering collision warnings. * **Manual Plugin Detection & Adoption:** Automatically recognizes plugins you installed manually via exact tree hash or `.git/config` origin so you can track updates and denylist alerts, with opt-in adoption for name-only matches. * **Search, Filters & Organization:** Filter by category, surface (`Sidebar UI`, `Prompt/Rules Only`, `Local MCP`, `Shell Hooks`), maximum risk tier, and credential requirements; favorite or hide plugins across sessions. --- ## Security Guarantees Every plugin in the registry is scanned by an automated, open-source GitHub Actions pipeline before publication, and the client enforces five local safeguards: 1. **Ed25519-Signed Registry & Rollback Protection:** `index.json` and `denylist.json` are signed with Ed25519. The client verifies signatures against a pinned public key and blocks replay of older signed catalogs or denylists. 2. **Immutable SHA Pinning + `contentTreeSha256`:** Plugins are never downloaded from mutable branches (`main`). Every install fetches the exact audited commit archive, blocks symlinks and zip-slip paths, and verifies the deterministic SHA-256 hash of the extracted file tree before moving files into your plugins directory. 3. **Emergency Denylist Kill-Switch:** Revoked repositories or compromised commit SHAs are checked live before every install and surfaced as red uninstall alerts if already installed. 4. **LLM Isolation:** Mutating tools (install, update, toggle, uninstall) are marked `visibility: ["app"]` so AI agents and untrusted prompts cannot invoke them—only your clicks in the sidebar UI can modify plugins. 5. **Code, Hook & Prompt-Injection Auditing:** Plugins are scanned with Semgrep AST rules, lifecycle hook checks, unpinned `npx`/`uvx` runtime checks, and Markdown prompt-injection heuristics (`SKILL.md`, `agents/*.md`, `rules/*.md`). Every finding links directly to the exact file and line number on GitHub. --- ## Permission Diffs & Pre-Flight Checks * **Mandatory Audit Gate:** Clicking **Update**, or installing any elevated/high-risk or credential-requiring plugin, opens the **Security Audit Drawer** before anything is downloaded. * **Permission Escalation Diffs:** On updates, the drawer compares your installed version's capabilities against the new version and highlights newly added permissions (such as a new `Shell Lifecycle Hook` or `Unpinned Remote Package`) in red. * **OS & Runtime Pre-Flight:** Before installing, the client checks your local `PATH` for required MCP/hook runtimes (`node`, `python3`, `uvx`, `docker`, `pwsh`) and warns if a shell hook uses POSIX-only syntax on Windows or Windows-only syntax on macOS/Linux. * **Live Collision Detection:** Warns if a plugin registers a `/slash` command, namespaced MCP server, or custom agent that conflicts with an active local plugin. --- ## Troubleshooting * **Installed or toggled plugin doesn't appear yet (or shows Pending Restart):** Antigravity loads MCP servers and lifecycle hooks on startup. If an active plugin's files are currently in use during an update, the verified update is staged automatically and finishes cleanly as soon as you close or restart the Antigravity App. * **"Select an active project path" on Project install:** When opened from the global sidebar, Antigravity may not attach a workspace root automatically. Click **Edit** in the top-right **Project** pill to enter your project's absolute path. * **"Untrusted signing keyId" or "Marketplace Update Available" (Red Banner):** The registry rotated its signing key or bumped the minimum supported schema. Update `agy-community-marketplace` to the latest release. * **"Integrity mismatch" on install:** The downloaded archive did not match the audited `contentTreeSha256`. Your existing installation is left untouched; click **Check Updates** and retry, or report the plugin if the error persists. * **Missing runtime warning in Pre-Flight:** Install the flagged binary (e.g., `uv` or `python3`), ensure it is on your system `PATH`, and restart the Antigravity App so the local MCP server picks up the updated environment. --- ## Submitting or Reporting a Plugin * **Submit / Refresh a Plugin:** Tag your public GitHub repository with `agy-plugin` or `antigravity-plugin` and open a submission issue on [`antigravity-plugin-registry`](https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-registry) for immediate indexing. * **Report a Malicious Plugin:** Click **Report** inside any plugin's detail drawer to open a pre-filled issue with the pinned commit SHA.
latestReleaseNotes:
### Improved
- **Seamless Active Plugin Updates:** Automatically updates active plugin files in place when folders are busy and stages updates in an isolated staging area to finish automatically when you restart the Antigravity App, using clean author-and-plugin folder names and allowing pending updates to be cancelled cleanly.
- **Reliable Background Update Completion:** Launches an independent background updater using your system Node runtime that waits until all Antigravity processes exit before completing staged plugin updates, keeps sidebar and background storage unified, prevents duplicate updaters from interrupting active updates, and records diagnostic logs for troubleshooting.
- **Plugin Manager Icon & Display Name:** Updated the plugin manifest so Antigravity's Plugins view displays the Community Plugins title and icon.
- **Rich README Rendering (Images, Tables & GitHub-Flavored Markdown):** Uses a bundled Markdown renderer with strict sanitization to display README images, badges, tables, nested lists, and release notes cleanly inside the plugin details drawer.
- **Clearer Update Review & Scope Safety:** Displays all release notes since your installed version alongside permission diffs when reviewing updates, automatically closes the detail drawer after confirming an update, places a Back button in the top-left of the detail drawer with the README & Notes tab first, shows a prominent amber pending-restart notice, prevents duplicate pending updates or repeated update clicks, enforces single-scope installs with clear warnings, treats matched local plugins like standard updates, shows update actions directly in Details, and surfaces action errors inside the drawer.
- **Safer Installed Plugin Controls:** Highlights **Disable** (or **Enable** when paused) as the default card action for up-to-date installed plugins—with **Update** kept primary whenever an update is available—and moves **Uninstall** into the action dropdown menu to prevent accidental removals.
